title: Invoice Manager Common Values v1
$comment: Resolve this stable identifier through the repository contract registry; validation must not fetch it from the network.

EntityId.description: Canonical lowercase, hyphenated UUIDv7 with an RFC-compatible variant. The value is opaque; timestamp ordering is not a business guarantee.

CurrencyCode.description: Exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. P0 defines structure only; domain contracts own any currency policy.

CanonicalInt64.description: Canonical signed decimal spelling. Regex-valid values still require checked runtime parsing within -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807.

NonNegativeInt64.description: Canonical nonnegative decimal spelling. Regex-valid values still require checked runtime parsing no greater than 9223372036854775807.

Money.description: Exact money at the shared wire layer. Signed minor units are intentional; contextual domains may narrow them without changing this contract.

LocalDate.description: Canonical Gregorian civil date with no timezone or time-of-day meaning. Pattern and format checks do not replace authoritative runtime Gregorian and supported-year validation.

UtcInstant.description: Canonical UTC instant with uppercase T and Z and exactly three fractional-second digits. Runtime validation rechecks the Gregorian date and clock ranges without normalization.

Sha256Digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 digest with an algorithm prefix and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

RequestId.description: Request correlation identifier using the exact EntityId wire representation.
